name: Lluvia de Peces!
source:
A short kinetic novel about friends, fish, and expatriates set in the city of Yoro, Honduras. The Lluvia de Peces is a strange, currently unexplained event where tons of fish appear lying and flopping about on the ground after the first large rain of the season. This rain of fish has been going on for quite some time, but only recently has a major festival been held after the rains end. For Adelita, who left Honduras to pursue academia, her return to the country marks her first time attending the festival, and the first time in a very long time that she’s seen one of her closest friends from her childhood…

[From [url=http://twinturtlegames.com/celebrate-the-rain-of-fish/]TwinTurtle Games[/url]]
translation:
这是一部关于朋友、鱼和外籍人士的短篇动态小说，以洪都拉斯约罗市为背景。Lluvia de Peces是一个奇怪的、目前无法解释的事件，在这个季节的第一场大雨过后，大量的鱼出现在地面上翻来覆去。这场鱼雨已经持续了很长一段时间，但直到最近雨季结束后才举行了一次重大节日。对于离开洪都拉斯追求学术事业的阿德丽塔来说，她回到这个国家标志着她第一次参加这个节日，也是她很长一段时间以来第一次见到她童年时期最亲密的朋友之一……

[来自[url=http://twinturtlegames.com/celebrate-the-rain-of-fish/]双龟游戏[/url]]
